post_call_analysis_data.description: City and state where the incident happened.

post_call_analysis_data.name: treatment
post_call_analysis_data.description: Medical treatment status (seen by a doctor, ER, none yet).

post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the police were called or a report was made.

post_call_analysis_data.name: existing_attorney

post_call_analysis_data.name: qualified
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the matter fits the firm's intake criteria.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgency
post_call_analysis_data.description: Lead urgency as judged by the agent.

post_call_analysis_data.name: transferred
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether a live transfer to the firm was attempted.

post_call_analysis_data.name: language
